{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      # The default branch, and where PRs merge to. Codecov needs a report on each
      # of its commits to have a baseline to compare pull requests against.
      - next
      # A hotfix branch is a tree that has never existed anywhere else, so it gets
      # its own run rather than relying on whoever prepared it locally.
      - 'hotfix/v*'
  pull_request:

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  main:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Normal runs take ~5 minutes; a hung browser test otherwise burns the 6h default.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # This job only reads the repo; nothing here runs an authenticated git command.
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: tree:0

      # Connect your workspace on nx.app and uncomment this to enable task distribution.
      # The "--stop-agents-after" is optional, but allows idle agents to shut down once the "build" targets have been requested
      # - run: pnpm exec nx-cloud start-ci-run --distribute-on="5 linux-medium-js" --stop-agents-after="build"

      # Must run before setup-node so that `cache: 'pnpm'` can resolve the store path.
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      # Cache the pnpm store
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - uses: nrwl/nx-set-shas@v5

      - run: pnpm exec nx format:check

      # Runs unconditionally rather than through `nx affected`: a change to
      # apps/components or to packages/tools never marks ng-primitives as affected, so
      # these checks would otherwise never fire on the PRs that change what the templates
      # are generated from.
      - name: Schematic templates are in sync and compile
        run: |
          pnpm exec nx run ng-primitives:build:templates
          git diff --exit-code -- packages/ng-primitives/schematics/ng-generate/templates \
            || { echo "::error::Schematic templates are stale. Run: nx run ng-primitives:build:templates"; exit 1; }
          pnpm exec nx run ng-primitives:test-node

      # scripts/ is not an nx project, so `nx affected` never covers it.
      - name: Release script tests
        run: pnpm test:scripts

      - run: pnpm exec nx affected -t lint,build,test
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: '--max-old-space-size=8192' # Increase memory to 8GB

      # Skipped when ng-primitives was not built. The release workflow runs the same check
      # before it publishes.
      - name: Packed schematics keep their CommonJS marker
        if: hashFiles('dist/packages/ng-primitives/package.json') != ''
        run: node scripts/check-packed-schematics.mjs

      # Skipped on PRs where ng-primitives isn't affected, so no report was produced.
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: hashFiles('coverage/packages/ng-primitives/coverage-final.json') != ''
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          files: coverage/packages/ng-primitives/coverage-final.json
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false

      # `nx affected` only builds the packages a PR touches, so a docs- or
      # components-only PR produces no `dist/packages/*` and `pkg-pr-new publish`
      # would fail with "No packages". Skip the preview publish when nothing was built.
      - name: Publish preview packages
        run: |
          if compgen -G "./dist/packages/*" > /dev/null; then
            pnpx pkg-pr-new publish ./dist/packages/*
          else
            echo "No library packages were affected; skipping preview package publish."
          fi
", "rationale": "The workflow runs CI on every push and pull request but has no concurrency cancellation, so a new push to the same branch/PR does not stop the superseded in-progress run, wasting runner time on stale checks. Adding a per-workflow/branch concurrency group with cancel-in-progress cancels superseded runs while preserving every existing step, check, and required status. This matches pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs), whose preconditions are met (same workflow/branch or PR; newer revision supersedes older checks) and whose contraindications do not apply (this is lint/build/test CI, not release or deployment work; the group keyed by github.ref keeps distinct branches isolated). Reported evidence: superseding runs can reduce duplicate work (free 1.9%, paid 4.1% VM time reduction). No permissions, secrets, publishing, or new network access is added.", "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]}
